Updates the CLI and bundled gateway to 0.15.0 and protocol 70. Generic capability controls expose Handoff and Swarm opt-in, apply declared policy exclusions, and explain unavailable choices. Swarm member selection respects each Bot's collaboration setting.

Upgrade with gateway 0.15.0; this release includes configuration and state schema changes described in the gateway release notes. Binary packages include both executables, pinned cloudflared, LICENSE, and NOTICE.
